name: TwoTrees TS2 40W
tagline: 40W TwoTrees' popular TS2 platform: 20W open-frame with active community
tldr: TwoTrees TS2 40W is the 40W SKU on the TwoTrees two trees ts2 line. The TS2 20W is one of TwoTrees' best-known laser lines: often compared to Ortur and Sculpfun at aggressive sale prices. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line: engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

priceRange.note: Official TwoTrees store, Oct 2026: $1,097 to $1,113 depending on Max version (US shipping only)

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Shortest times of the TS2 line in our benchmark: ~12–18 min for a 10 × 10 cm photo, ~6–10 min for a 3 mm basswood square
Basswood up to 10 mm in our profile, with fill speeds of 70–150 mm/s
Keeps the TS2's automatic focus and 410 × 400 mm bed
cons: Price varies widely: TwoTrees' own store listed the TS2-40W at $1,097 with US shipping only (October 2026), far above many reseller listings
Wider spot (~0.09 mm) and more smoke than the 20W: plan exhaust and air assist
Dark acrylic still tops out around 5 mm in our profile: clear acrylic needs CO₂
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 40W SKU on TwoTrees TS2. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.

editorialDepth.advantages: TwoTrees TS2 40W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.

faq.question: Where can I buy the TS2 40W, and at what price?
faq.answer: In October 2026 TwoTrees' own store listed the TS2-40W at $1,097 and the TS2-40W Max at $1,113, both with US shipping only. Reseller prices are often much lower; check that the listing states 40W optical output and that warranty is handled in your country.

faq.question: What does the 40W gain over the TS2 20W?
faq.answer: Speed above all. In our benchmark the 10 × 10 cm photo drops from ~18–28 min to ~12–18 min and the 3 mm basswood square from ~9–15 min to ~6–10 min, with cut speeds of 4–11 mm/s. Our profile also moves the basswood limit from 8 to 10 mm.

faq.question: Is the TS2 40W a good fit for a small production shop?
faq.answer: For daily cutting of 3–6 mm wood, yes: the time saved per job is what justifies it. For photo-heavy work, the 20W's finer spot (~0.08 mm vs ~0.09 mm) and lower price are the better match.

standoutFeatures.title: Fastest TS2
standoutFeatures.body: ~12–18 min for a 10 × 10 cm photo and ~6–10 min for a 3 mm basswood square in our benchmark, the best times of the line.

standoutFeatures.title: Basswood up to 10 mm
standoutFeatures.body: Our profile lists 10 mm basswood and 5 mm dark acrylic, with cut speeds of 4–11 mm/s on 3 mm wood.
